title: Art Object
content:
Type: ARTO
Papyrus: None An Art Object represents a visual effect used by various game systems such as the Workshop. The Art Object object is found within the Object Window under the Miscellaneous Category. Editor Dialog: File:Art Object Editor.png - - Art Type: The type of effect object (enchantment effect, casting effect, or hit effect); indicates what the object can be used for. - - - See Also: - Miscellaneous Category
